statements.summary: Students and staff authenticate using their existing college account.

statements.summary: Users can search rooms by date, time, and capacity, and book an individual one-off slot.

statements.summary: The system prevents double bookings by rejecting overlapping reservations for the same room.

citations.quote: The main thing for us is ending double bookings. If two people can take the same room at the same time, we have failed.
The booking service will reject an overlapping booking for the same room. That part is straightforward.

statements.summary: Maximum booking duration is conflicting between 4 hours (brief) and 3 hours (transcript).

citations.quote: A booking can last up to 4 hours.
The brief says four hours, but three hours is the most I want for a single booking, or rooms get hogged.

statements.summary: The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance.

citations.quote: The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance.

statements.summary: Facilities Office can view all bookings including booker identity, while students can only see that a room is taken without booker details.

citations.quote: Give the Facilities Office a single view of all bookings.
Also, my office needs to see who booked each room. Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it.

statements.summary: Recurring bookings are excluded from the first release.

citations.quote: Not in the first release. Recurring bookings make the clash rules much harder, so let's leave recurring bookings out for now and revisit after launch.
Agreed. Recurring reservations are out of scope for release one.

statements.summary: Outlook calendar synchronisation is proposed but not committed.

citations.quote: Maybe we could also sync bookings to people's Outlook calendars? It might be nice.
Possibly, but let's not commit to that today.

statements.summary: Handling of cancellations and no-shows remains unagreed pending discussion with Student Services.

citations.quote: We have not yet agreed what happens when someone cannot attend a booking. The Facilities Office will discuss this with Student Services.
We need a rule for no-shows, and for how late someone can cancel, but I have to check with Student Services first.
Okay, cancellation and no-shows stay open until Dana confirms.

items.title: Room Search and Self-Service Booking
items.description: Enable students and staff to sign in with college credentials, search room availability, and reserve one-off study room slots without clashes.

criteria.text: Students and staff can sign in using existing college credentials.

citations.quote: Students and staff sign in with their existing college account.

criteria.text: Users can view room availability and book an individual slot with conflict prevention.

citations.quote: Let students and staff see which study rooms are free and book one themselves.
The booking service will reject an overlapping booking for the same room. That part is straightforward.

open_questions: What is the maximum allowed duration for a booking (4 hours vs 3 hours)?

items.title: Facilities Administration and Schedule Oversight
items.description: Provide the Facilities Office with administrative controls to monitor all bookings and block rooms for maintenance.

criteria.text: Facilities staff have a comprehensive view of all room bookings including booker identities.

citations.quote: Give the Facilities Office a single view of all bookings.
Also, my office needs to see who booked each room. Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it.

criteria.text: Facilities staff can block rooms from being booked due to maintenance.

citations.quote: The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance.

criteria.text: Users authenticate using their existing college account.

citations.quote: Students and staff sign in with their existing college account.

items.title: Search Rooms by Date, Time, and Capacity
items.description: As a signed-in user, I want to search for study rooms based on date, time, and room capacity so that I can identify suitable available options.

criteria.text: Users can search rooms filtering by date, time, and capacity.

citations.quote: A user can search rooms by date, time and capacity, and book an individual one-off slot.

criteria.text: Search results show which rooms are free without exposing the identities of other users who booked occupied rooms.

citations.quote: Let students and staff see which study rooms are free and book one themselves.
Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it.

items.title: Book a Single Study Room Slot
items.description: As a signed-in user, I want to book an available room for a single session so that my group has a reserved space.

criteria.text: The user can confirm a booking for an individual one-off slot.

citations.quote: A user can search rooms by date, time and capacity, and book an individual one-off slot.

criteria.text: The booking duration does not exceed the allowed maximum limit.

open_questions: Should the maximum booking duration limit be 3 hours or 4 hours?

items.title: Prevent Overlapping Bookings
items.description: As a user, I want the system to reject conflicting bookings so that no room is double-booked.

criteria.text: The booking system automatically rejects any booking that overlaps with an existing reservation for the same room.

citations.quote: The booking service will reject an overlapping booking for the same room. That part is straightforward.

citations.quote: Also, my office needs to see who booked each room. Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it.

items.title: Block Room for Maintenance
items.description: As the Facilities Office, I want to block a study room for maintenance so that users cannot book it while unavailable.

criteria.text: Facilities staff can place a maintenance block on a room, rendering that room unavailable for booking.

citations.quote: The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance.

Okay, cancellation and no-shows stay open until Dana confirms.
